talk.label.author: Issue author
talk.maturity.line: No AI → Exploratory → Structured → Scaled → Governed & Optimized
talk.local.title:
You work with AI
on your PC.
talk.local.body: You supply context, review the change and give the next instruction.
talk.maturity.levels.title:
Adoption and maturity
are different.
talk.maturity.levels.body: A new agent does not change team practices. Maturity depends on standards, control and outcomes.
talk.maturity.areas.title: We assess four areas.
talk.maturity.areas.body: SDLC 35% · determinism 25% · control 20% · impact 20%. We assess team practices.
talk.evolution.path.title:
From prompts
to a Harness.
talk.evolution.path.body: A skill keeps the procedure. An agent uses tools. Plugins limit those tools. The Harness installs all of this in the repo.
talk.evolution.async.title: The next step is asynchronous.
talk.evolution.async.body: A repository event starts the work. The process continues after you leave the PC.
talk.platform.chapter.title: How we built Platform
talk.platform.pillars.title:
Four repositories
carry the method.
talk.platform.pillars.body: Foundations sets conventions. agent-harness installs them for agents. agentic-workflows runs the agents. project-health measures the result.
talk.platform.phases.title:
Discovery → Foundations
→ Maintenance
talk.platform.phases.body: Early work builds the technical and agent base. With that in place, more effort goes into defining the product.
talk.foundations.chapter.title: Foundations
talk.foundations.guardrails.title:
A guardrail
fails the build.
talk.foundations.guardrails.body: One stack for people and agents. The linter blocks cross-layer code. A behavior change needs a spec. A test must assert behavior.
talk.foundations.owners.title:
Protected paths
need an owner.
talk.foundations.owners.body: Authentication, migrations, integrations and CI configuration stop for an owner. Green tests do not override that.
talk.harness.contents.title:
agent-harness
sets up the environment.
talk.harness.contents.body: One command installs pc-* skills, commands, agents, plugins and OpenSpec. The bootstrap writes ARCHITECTURE.md and DESIGN.md from the code.
talk.harness.runtime.title:
One Harness
on PC and CI.
talk.harness.runtime.body: Plugins reject unsafe tool calls before they run. OpenCode reads the same repo rules on both. Forge supplies the model.
talk.workflows.chapter.title: Agentic Workflows
talk.workflows.router.title: One router for every event.
talk.workflows.router.body: A Markdown file compiles to a GitHub Actions workflow. Shell code classifies the event and calls at most one worker, or none.
talk.workflows.hybrid.title:
Jobs → agent → jobs
→ Safe Outputs
talk.workflows.hybrid.body: Jobs collect facts. The agent decides with read-only access. Validators check its result. Safe Outputs applies only allowed writes.
talk.workflows.refine.title:
Refine: from Issue
to story.
talk.workflows.refine.body: It reads the code and writes testable criteria with an estimate. It asks the author when intent is missing. Large Issues split into children.
talk.workflows.implement.title: Implement: code, checks and PR.
talk.workflows.implement.body: Prepare the Issue → /plan-goal → validate the patch → open PR. The worker stops there.
talk.workflows.gate.title:
CI supplies evidence.
Merge Gate decides.
talk.workflows.gate.body: Code computes risk. The agent looks for defects. A validator sets the verdict. Fixes and reviews return through CI to the same gate.
talk.workflows.gate.command: CI → Merge Gate → merge · fix → CI
talk.health.chapter.title: Project Health
talk.health.measure.title:
Health measures
what GitHub knows.
talk.health.measure.body: Deployment frequency, lead time and rework. Tokens per run, as a floor. Work that waits for a person. A missing value stays empty.
talk.health.improve.title: Audit sends work back to Refine.
talk.health.improve.body: A read-only audit files an Issue through the same route. Health measures the result of the change.
talk.system.title:
From Issue to production
with GitHub Agentic Workflows.
talk.system.body: Product experts who do not code file small eligible Issues or bugs. They reach production without human supervision.
